stem:
Priya stands between a lamp and a white wall in her room at home. Her brother observes the wall from the other side.
In which situation will the darkest shadow form on the wall?

options.text: Priya holds a thin glass sheet in front of the lamp.
Priya holds a thick wooden board in front of the lamp.
Priya holds a sheet of tracing paper in front of the lamp.
Priya switches the lamp off and holds a wooden board.

teacher.key_rationale: A shadow forms where light is blocked from reaching a screen. The wooden board is fully opaque, so it blocks the most light and gives the darkest shadow. Glass (A) lets most light through, tracing paper (C) lets some light through so its shadow is faint, and with the lamp off (D) no shadow forms at all.
